proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Exterior loops invalidate the area-to-local-length estimate

1<=n<=1+delta and 1-delta<=x<=1; counterexample n=x=1. Arbitrary exterior boundary loop configuration is allowed. Uniform interior face, independent of loop configuration. No bi-infinite paths in counterexample. V uses global outermost surrounding loop; L is longest bordering loop.

Recorded check: Full-cube bijection has redundant face coordinates

Single hexagon domain; fixed empty uncolored loop configuration. Six edge bits and one face bit. n=1, 0<x<1 for full positive edge support.

repair.content:
Define V_D using inclusion-maximal internal loops. Pathwise average 1{V_D>s} <=36c average L1{L>sqrt(s/c)}. Under UI, fixed-r crossings vanish as R grows, with boundary error O(r/k). First clause then gives arbitrarily large r and fixed R with liminf surrounding probability>=1/2. Discard width-R boundary strip O(R/k), choose s_r=|F_Lambda_r|/2, obtain tail lower bound1/(72c), contradicting UI.

Replace full cube by deterministic-face-rule subset.
